lineage.reason_for_new_lineage: User authorized a new ERK modal lineage after preserving the v1 complete-8D arbitrary-direction round-trip failure.

native_science_rationale.question: Do the complete native invariant modal carriers of the qualified 8D ERK generator reproduce the nonlinear source-native dynamics in their declared local subspaces?
native_science_rationale.representation: all real one-dimensional eigenspaces plus all real two-dimensional invariant subspaces generated by complex-conjugate eigenpairs of the qualified reduced generator
native_science_rationale.why_this_is_distinct_from_v1: v1 perturbed eight fixed source-stoichiometric directions spanning the 8D dynamic space; v2 perturbs the invariant carriers of the local generator itself
native_science_rationale.literature_collision_disposition: Eigenmodes/eigenvectors of biochemical Jacobians are standard local dynamic modes, and invariant-subspace/Schur constructions are established in chemical and biochemical time-scale analysis. This supports the carrier question independently of the favorable or unfavorable v1 directions.

generator.stoichiometric_subspace: same frozen 8D col(S) used in B3 generator v0.2

real_mode.definition: each numerically real eigenvalue and its one-dimensional right-eigenvector eigenspace
real_mode.directions: both signs of the normalized physical-space eigenvector Q v
real_mode.orientation: sign is not used for selection because both signs are tested

complex_pair.definition: each unique complex-conjugate pair and its two-dimensional real invariant subspace
complex_pair.phase_rule: rotate the positive-imaginary eigenvector by exp(-i arg(C_r v)) when C_r v is nonzero; otherwise use deterministic largest-component phase
complex_pair.directions: both signs of normalized Re(Q v_phase) and both signs of normalized Im(Q v_phase)

carrier_construction.real_vs_complex_classification_floor: sqrt(eps) * max_i |lambda_i| for residual imaginary components

nonlinear_roundtrip.real_mode_horizon: 5/|Re(lambda)| for Re(lambda)<0; nonnegative real modes are reported and refused from decay-roundtrip interpretation
nonlinear_roundtrip.linear_prediction: complete expm(J_r t) evolution from the invariant-carrier initial condition, with analytic carrier evolution used as an implementation self-check

metrics.primary: relative Frobenius/L2 error across all 15 physical-state displacements
metrics.biological_output: relative L2 error of deterministic source-native FRET displacement when both frozen linear predictions have nonzero norm
metrics.implementation_self_check: analytic carrier evolution versus complete expm(J_r t) from the same invariant-carrier initial condition

primary_pass_rule.per_direction: all-state error at 1e-4 must be lower than at 1e-3; FRET error must also decrease when both are defined; all values finite
primary_pass_rule.per_carrier: every frozen direction in the carrier passes
primary_pass_rule.per_context: every real-mode and complex-pair carrier passes
primary_pass_rule.overall: all carriers pass in all four source-defined lane/context combinations
primary_pass_rule.sensitivity_1e-5: reported as Limit Map evidence and cannot overturn the frozen primary 1e-3 to 1e-4 adjudication

admission_rule: A PASS licenses model-specific ERK Chi_bio under the v2 invariant-carrier representation at P0-Q while preserving the v1 arbitrary-direction Limit Map as a distinct failed stronger/general-direction question. A failure preserves ERK Chi_bio refusal.
next_after_result: record v2 finding, then create a unified ERK modal lineage record containing v1 question/result/limit, v2 question/result, promotion debt, and current cross-system disposition
